name: medifirst-merged
description: MediFirst monorepo — one install, one dev command, one production server

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && rag_service\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r rag_service\requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -k --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend,rag --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:rag"
